status: Complete bounded investigation. All runtime candidates rejected; no production optimization accepted.
metric_definition: Positive time_reduction_pct = 100*(1-candidate_median/baseline_median). Group aggregates use equal-weight geometric means of time ratios.
artifact_path_note: Executable paths are historical locations at measurement time. A later experiment may overwrite a path; measured SHA-256 is the artifact identity. The original strings-wsl candidate path was reused for a baseline control build.

validation.disposition: Rejected despite semantic checks passing. Windows Jelly median time increased 2.355389358%; all six measured candidate times exceeded every baseline time. Full-suite gains were only 1.958783930% Windows and 1.193842178% WSL.
